position: Implementation permission is narrower than deployment and never implies activation
headline: One bounded decision can be reviewed without creating an account, endpoint, credential, or invitation.
copy: The current record keeps the decision pending until a provider candidate, region, budget, owners, dry-run manifest, private mode, readiness status, and founder authorization are all explicit.

postures.title: Decision evaluator
postures.copy: Nine prerequisites and three unsafe-state checks are deterministic.

postures.title: Founder implementation decision
postures.copy: No real provider or budget decision has been recorded.

postures.title: Deployment
postures.copy: Even complete evidence returns a no-deployment result.

postures.title: External access
postures.copy: Invitations and participants must remain zero.

flow.title: Name
flow.copy: Record provider candidate, region, budget, and owners.

flow.title: Verify
flow.copy: Confirm readiness, dry-run manifest, and private mode.

flow.title: Decide
flow.copy: Authorize bounded implementation, reject, or remain pending.

flow.title: Hold
flow.copy: Keep deployment, writes, credentials, and invitations closed.

decisions.label: Evaluator
decisions.reason: Complete and unsafe states are covered by tests.

decisions.label: Current decision
decisions.reason: Real provider inputs are intentionally absent.

locks.title: Credential lock
locks.copy: No secret value or reviewer credential is generated.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external account, runtime, endpoint, or domain is created.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: The decision surfaces cannot issue an invitation.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No external participant or public session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private implementation evidence cannot open public launch.
